subject: Request: transient H100/H200 mix + reservation hold and overage concession for VeloxAI
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot@veloxai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask: transient H100 + H200 mix and overage terms

Marissa —

Thanks for the demo today. Our infra team ran the workload profile and we have a short, high-intensity phase expected Oct–Nov that will need an H100 high-memory variant for ~3 weeks, then heavier but lower-latency inference on H200 for the following month.

We'd like to reserve a base pool (12x H200 equivalent) for steady traffic and request transient burst access to up to 6 H100-equivalent instances for the Oct spike. Two asks:
- Can you hold capacity (soft reservation) for the Oct window while we finish procurement?
- Can Redwood provide a capped overage rate for H100 bursts (we're sensitive to unlimited surcharge)?

Also, procurement will need a one-time (12 month) commitment with a small discount off list pricing to meet our ROI model.

Attached is a simple usage forecast (VeloxAI_Projected_Usage_2026Q4.xlsx). Happy to jump on a quick call.

Cheers,
Elliot
Head of Infra
VeloxAI

Elliot —

Appreciate the detail and the forecast — this is doable but will require an exceptions path:
- Soft reservation (30-day hold) for requested Oct spike while procurement completes.
- A bounded overage cap on H100 bursts (we can propose a per-hour cap rather than open-market pricing).
- A 12-month reserved term with a small volume discount; the exact % depends on committed baseline.

I will need exec sign-off for the reservation hold and the H100 overage cap (these are non-standard given H100 supply constraints). Looping in Karthik (deals) and Lauren (sales operations / exec sign) to request approval and any suggested conditional language for the SOW.

Proposed next steps:
1) Karthik/Marissa to confirm allowable overage cap and conditional hold terms for October.
2) Draft SOW reflecting transient burst window and billing cap, circulate to Velox procurement.
3) DocuSign route once terms approved.

I'll attach a draft SOW and a quick pricing sketch for clarity.

Thanks —
Marissa

Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity ask: transient H100 + H200 mix and overage terms

Hi Karthik / Lauren —

Forwarding Elliott's ask. Key points for approval:
- Soft reservation: 30-day hold starting 2026-10-01 on up to 6 H100-equivalent transient nodes (non-preemptible) so Velox can finalize PO. Hold would not charge unless converted to reservation; it removes capacity from open inventory for that window.
- Baseline reservation: 12x H200-equivalent steady pool, 12-month term.
- Overage: propose a capped H100 burst rate of $15/hr per unit (50% above our standard H200 burst rate), capped monthly at $4,000 for the Oct window to keep their spend predictable.
- Discount: 8% off hosted/Dedicated list for the 12-month committed baseline (volume contingent).

We have capacity in us-west region but H100 is tight in Oct. This is a medium commercial-sized request; I recommend approval conditioned on:
1) Customer signs SOW + PO within 14 days of hold being placed,
2) Billing cap applies only to bursts scheduled within Oct 1–31, 2026,
3) Any additional H100 beyond 6 units will be charged at standard on-demand premium.

Why approve: meaningful annual revenue opportunity and referenceable AI infra customer. Risk: holding H100 reduces inventory for other high-value deals for that window.

Asks:
- Karthik: confirm that 8% discount + $15/hr capped at $4k for Oct is within deal desk authority or needs Exec sign-off.
- Lauren: can you approve the soft 30-day hold and the overage cap conditionally? If you want different guardrails I can update SOW language.

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa / Karthik —

After reviewing inventory and commercial impact, I approve the following, with strict conditions:

Approved items:
- Soft reservation (30-day hold) for up to 6 H100-equivalent instances for Oct 1–31, 2026, to be placed immediately upon SLA addendum execution.
- Bounded overage rate: $15/hr per H100-equivalent unit, with a monthly cap of $4,000 for the Oct window (applies only to units in the held cohort).
- One-time commercial concession: 8% discount on the 12-month committed baseline (12x H200-equivalent).

Conditions (must be in SOW / PO):
1) PO/Signed SOW within 14 calendar days of the hold being placed; otherwise the hold is released.
2) Redlines to SOW must include explicit language limiting the billing cap to Oct 1–31, 2026.
3) Any extension of the hold or additional H100 allocation requires separate approval from Sales Ops.
4) Legal to review service level addendum and indemnities; no material change to standard risk posture.

Marissa — please update the SOW with the approved language, circulate to Velox procurement and Legal, and route to DocuSign. Copy me on the HubSpot deal update (use the HubSpot link). Once PO is received, Ops will convert the hold to a reservation and provision the baseline.

Thanks —
